summary: Resolve one explicit notice owner against its exact admitted fleet member incarnation without automatic election.

replay.detail: Owner resolution checks the selected declaration and competing causal desired heads, quarantined prerequisites and admitted membership. A canonical or receive-order winner is not an ownership decision.

schema.detail: The internal binding retains the declaration claim, subject, member subject, immutable admission claim and admitted member public key. It is a fleet member incarnation, not an agent or terminal process incarnation.

rules.detail: A missing, duplicate, conflicted, ended, nonmember or mismatched owner is explicitly unavailable. Graph admission refuses a second retained owner and validates the authored always-on qualification against the exact current admitted incarnation. No fallback owner is elected.

compatibility.detail: Desired owner intent does not itself acknowledge ownership or authorize a receipt. The owner acknowledgement fence and receipt causal-position authorization remain separate; receipt admission stays pending and delivery stays unknown until that authority exists.

manual.detail: Publish one reviewed owner declaration bound to an admitted member incarnation with explicit always-on=true. A changed member incarnation needs an explicit new binding.

recovery.detail: Restore a unique valid binding and admitted member. Unreachable-owner recovery does not silently choose another member; revocation takes effect only at the separately established owner's acknowledgement fence.
